    act() - Method in class pong.Pong
    Runs every frame and basically controls the whole game Counts down the clock, moves the paddles, starts the timeline events, bounces the balls off paddles and walls, adds points and checks for a winner Precondition: setup() has already run Postcondition: everything is updated for this frame, scores are updated if someone scored, and the game stops if someone won or the clock ran out
    actionPerformed(ActionEvent) - Method in class pong.Zetamac
    Called by the clock every TICK_MS, and by the text box when Enter is pressed.
    activate(Paddle, Paddle, int) - Method in class pong.Powerup
    Turns the powerup on, then turns it off again after durationMs Precondition: both paddles are in the game Postcondition: the effect is on and a timer is set to undo it
    activate(Paddle, Paddle, int) - Method in class pong.SizePowerup
    Grows the player's paddle, then shrinks it back to normal after durationMs Postcondition: player's paddle is taller and a timer is set to reset its size
    activate(Paddle, Paddle, int) - Method in class pong.SlowPowerup
    Slows the opponent's paddle, then the paddle is back to normal after durationMs Postcondition: opponent is slowed and a timer is set to unslow it
    activate(Paddle, Paddle, int) - Method in class pong.SpeedPowerup
    Boosts the player's paddle, then turns the boost off after durationMs, since all powerups will expire eventually, i set a duration ms as the expiration second Postcondition: player is boosted and a timer is set to unboost it

    bounceLeft() - Method in class pong.Ball
    Makes the ball go left, used when it hits the right paddle Same idea as bounceRight() so it can't get stuck inside the paddle either Precondition: the ball is touching the right paddle Postcondition: dx is negative so the ball moves left
    bounceRandomX(int) - Method in class pong.Ball
    Sets the left/right speed of a volley ball so it flies away from whoever shot it Uses cos of the random angle, so balls that go more up or down move sideways slower
    bounceRandomY(int) - Method in class pong.Ball
    Sets the up/down speed of a volley ball using sin of the random angle Every ball gets a different angle so the volley spreads out instead of all going in a straight line
    bounceRight() - Method in class pong.Ball
    Makes the ball go right, used when it hits the left paddle I set the direction instead of just flipping it so the ball can't get stuck inside the paddle and keep switching back and forth Precondition: the ball is touching the left paddle Postcondition: dx is positive so the ball moves right
